name: Taiken Kokuhaku ~Kiite Hoshii no~
original_name: 体験告白 ～聞いて欲しいの～
source:
Main character is an editor of magazine "S-teen" for young girls. Originally he collected confessions and summarized them to present for readers, but eventually decided to publish interviews entirely, because girls and confessions situations are so bright and unique.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是少女杂志《S-teen》的编辑。最初他收集自白并总结出来呈现给读者，但最终决定完全发表采访，因为女孩和自白的情况是如此明亮和独特。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
